public.title: Move Zeroes
public.description: Return an array containing all nonzero elements of values in their original relative order, followed by all its zeroes. Keep the same length and number of zeroes. The input has 0 to 1000 integers between -1000000 and 1000000. Return the resulting array; mutating the input is allowed but not required. Aim for linear time.
hints: Preserve the order of nonzero values, then fill the remaining positions with zeroes.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Collect nonzero elements in order and append zeroes until the original length is reached. This takes O(n) time and O(n) output space. An in-place write pointer is also valid.
